context.projectOverview: agent-bober: multi-agent TypeScript/ESM CLI + MCP harness. This spec makes the code-graph layer pluggable between tokensave (default) and code-review-graph. Sprint 1 is a PURE REFACTOR: extract a GraphBackend abstraction and a TokensaveBackend that reproduces today's exact behavior; GraphClient delegates tool-name/params/narrow to the injected backend while keeping all cross-cutting logic. tokensave path MUST stay byte-identical.
context.keyReference: The pre-remap client.ts at `git show 6ed3f77~1:src/graph/client.ts` shows the same code before the tokensave 6.1.1 remap — useful for understanding the seam, but Sprint 1 only extracts CURRENT tokensave behavior.

principles: TypeScript strict mode, zero type errors is a hard gate. ESM everywhere: `.js` import specifiers for NodeNext, no CommonJS. `import type { ... }` (consistent-type-imports enforced). No `any` without justification (prefer unknown + narrowing). No synchronous fs (node:fs/promises only). Unicode box-drawing section headers `// -- Section --`. Small focused util modules. Conventional commits; sprint commits use `bober(sprint-N): description`. Zod for config validation. Contract-based filesystem state under .bober/. Never import provider SDKs outside providers/ adapters. Work on the feature branch, never main.
